mRemoteNG assets-only reference subset

Upstream: https://github.com/mRemoteNG/mRemoteNG.git
Commit: 4ad1c794fe2389cc5ca0bb1d271f009f44f6e0e6

Only the image files named in manifest.json are retained. Resources/ and Icons/
files are byte-for-byte copies from that revision. reference/reconnect.png and
reference/external-tools.png are exact decoded standalone byte arrays from the
named mRemoteNG/UI/Window/ConnectionWindow.resx entries in the manifest. No .NET
code, full .resx source, object deserialization or full upstream clone is required
by the build or preview. The obsolete application logo is excluded; the
Icons/mRemoteNG.ico connection-profile compatibility icon is intentionally kept.

COPYING.txt and CREDITS.md are unmodified upstream files. COPYING.txt contains
GPL v2. Aggregate CREDITS.md notices include the Silk Icon Set, copyright
2005-2008 FAMFAMFAM, CC BY 2.5, and PuTTY, copyright 1997-2017 Simon Tatham, MIT.
These aggregate notices are not a per-image license assignment. Components
credited by upstream are not necessarily included in this subset.

Per-image rights are unresolved. Aggregate upstream notices do not establish the license of each image. The images are redistributed with CMRemote under the terms of the upstream GPL v2 distribution, with its notices.
CMRemote itself is licensed GPL-2.0-or-later; see LICENSE at the project root.
This NOTICE.txt is local migration metadata;
it is not an upstream notice or a replacement license.
